blocking: [claude] Lost-update hole in the update concurrency contract: C/project/docs/workspace-access.md:113 keys the read-version observation "by grant (or browser editing session) and document" and says "Return/update the observation after a successful write", while claiming "Do not silently overwrite edits made since the observed version." A grant belongs to person+client (:54), so two agent sessions or sub-agents on the same grant both read v1, session B writes v2 and advances the shared observation to v2, then session A's stale write compares v2==v2 and silently overwrites B. The doc admits "independent parallel editors need separate editing contexts" but specifies no way to get one under the fixed `{ id, content }` signature, so the shipped behavior contradicts its own guarantee.
